responsibility: Template for the generated LoongArch target option table. It declares the target-visible enums, variables, and option records for -march, -mtune, -mfpu, -mabi, -mcmodel, floating-point mode switches, and other backend knobs, using placeholder tokens that genstr.sh replaces from the LoongArch string table to produce the final loongarch.opt consumed by GCC’s option machinery.
